activation_rule: Activated by the user's explicit direction to begin the first sprint and operate autonomously until 2:00 AM America/New_York.
objective: Advance Agentic Wiki from passive source-backed storage into the deterministic memory runtime for agent-development-coordinator, allowing long-running development to observe events, preserve evidence, propose controlled memory changes, compile bounded context, assess impact, govern promotion, and resume after context loss.

architecture.principle: Agentic Wiki remains deterministic and inspectable; the plugin supplies coordination and reasoning.

memory_layers.purpose: Mutable queue, leases, blockers, and current validation state.
Proposed knowledge awaiting validation or authority.
Accepted semantic HTML knowledge with provenance and relationships.
Immutable sources, historical snapshots, and superseded records.

architecture.writer_policy: Workers submit memory delta packets; only the coordinator writes shared memory and disposes drafts.
architecture.storage_policy: Use a dedicated local Agentic Wiki workspace. BMAD remains a project control-plane adapter, not the memory engine or a plugin dependency.
architecture.cloudflare_assessment: Excluded from the core architecture. Local plain-file storage is the default; publication is a future project-specific opt-in.

two_hour_run.target_release: local agentic-memory vertical slice and agent-development-coordinator integration
definition_of_done: A typed development event can become an immutable source and provenance-backed draft wiki page.
A coordinator can validate a worker memory delta and generate a bounded context package.
Impact analysis reports affected records without silently changing canonical knowledge.
Design principles, references, screen metadata, and visual validation evidence can be stored and retrieved as project-local memory.
Preflight records whether the project handles PHI and enables synthetic-only development behavior when the answer is yes or still unknown.
Promotion policy distinguishes autonomous operational updates from supervision-required changes.
Python API, CLI, and capability metadata expose equivalent structured operations.
The local plugin includes memory-steward behavior and remains project-agnostic.
Focused and full repository validation pass, plugin validation passes, and a durable handoff is rendered.
stop_conditions: queue drain with all planned acceptance gates passing
safety, privacy, permission, or supervision boundary with no independent work
no safe independent or enabling slice remains

intake_and_phi_policy.required_question: Will the application being developed create, receive, maintain, transmit, display, or otherwise handle PHI?

yes.screenshots: synthetic state or verified deidentified capture only

no.screenshots: follow project privacy and credential rules

unknown.next_action: Place the unanswered PHI question in the supervision queue without blocking unrelated synthetic development.

intake_and_phi_policy.compliance_boundary: These behaviors support privacy-conscious development and do not claim legal certification or replace project-specific compliance review.

design_memory.purpose: Preserve visual direction and provide agents with consistent design context across features, screens, roles, viewports, and application states.
agent_behavior: Compile relevant design principles, tokens, component patterns, approved screens, responsive rules, accessibility requirements, and known variances before frontend work.
Capture visual evidence after material frontend slices at project-required viewports and states.
Compare new evidence with accepted references and create a visual validation result.
Record material divergence as a design variance instead of silently changing the baseline.
Supersede prior references without deleting historical evidence.
Link design memory to implementation files, tests, routes, components, features, and user flows.
design_memory.storage_boundary: Images are immutable project-local sources with hashes; explanatory and approved design knowledge is semantic HTML with provenance. No project design assets are embedded in reusable plugin defaults.

contracts.purpose: Immutable observation of a meaningful project event.
Worker-proposed typed additions, corrections, links, supersessions, and follow-up obligations.
Bounded request identifying slice, objective, scope, allowed memory types, and budget.
Relevant accepted knowledge, evidence, warnings, authority, and citations for one task.
Affected components, slices, validations, pages, decisions, and supervision needs.
Coordinator decision to promote, retain as draft, reject, supersede, or request supervision.
Accepted or proposed visual, interaction, responsive, accessibility, and brand guidance.
Hashed screenshot or mockup reference with route, role, viewport, state, revision, PHI status, and provenance.
Evidence-backed comparison between implementation output and accepted design memory.
Material deviation, rationale, affected screens or components, authority need, and proposed disposition.

phases.name: Baseline and contract freeze
tasks: Classify the existing dirty tree and preserve all unrelated changes.
Run focused baseline tests before behavior changes.
Finalize typed contracts, lifecycle states, provenance, authority, and prohibited sensitive-value fields.
Require and persist the PHI-handling answer; use precautionary synthetic-only behavior while the answer is unknown.
Finalize design-memory types, screenshot metadata, immutable image storage, and visual-reference promotion rules.
Freeze the two-hour scope; defer MCP, dashboards, background daemons, remote models, and Cloudflare.
acceptance: All ten contracts have machine-readable schemas and examples.
The intent contract requires a yes, no, or unknown PHI answer and maps it to deterministic development behavior.
EMR concepts appear only in synthetic tests and never in reusable defaults.
Baseline focused tests pass or an evidence-backed blocker is recorded.

phases.name: Event-to-draft memory vertical slice
tasks: Validate typed memory events and memory delta packets.
Register event packets as immutable Agentic Wiki sources.
Create semantic HTML drafts, claims, links, and event records with provenance.
Implement idempotence, correction through supersession, and PHI/secret-value rejection.
acceptance: A synthetic claims-integration variance produces a source-backed draft.
Reprocessing identical source content does not create duplicate evidence.
Supersession preserves both records and identifies the current record.

phases.name: Context, impact, and design-memory analysis
tasks: Generate bounded context packages from active typed records and explicit relationships.
Exclude superseded records by default and report stale or contradictory active records.
Traverse relationships to report affected slices, components, validations, pages, and decisions.
Store design principles, component patterns, screen references, visual validation results, and design variances as typed project-local memory.
Compile bounded frontend design context and compare synthetic-state screenshots or mockups with accepted references.
Produce proposed follow-up work without directly changing the active queue.
acceptance: A synthetic patient-identity change identifies related scheduling, portal, claims, and audit consumers.
Unrelated work is excluded from the impact report.
Context output is bounded structured JSON with citations and staleness warnings.
A synthetic frontend slice retrieves applicable principles, component patterns, viewports, approved references, and accessibility rules.
A material visual difference produces a design variance and does not silently replace the approved baseline.

phases.name: Public API, CLI, and capabilities
acceptance: Python and CLI operations return equivalent structured results.
Capabilities declare mutation, write location, dry-run or check-only support, and PHI requirements.
AgenticWikiWorkspace remains canonical and MemwikiWorkspace remains compatible.
All generated knowledge follows draft-before-promote behavior.

phases.name: Plugin integration
tasks: Add an agent-dev-memory-steward skill.
Update preflight to ask whether the project handles PHI, persist yes, no, or unknown, and initialize or discover a dedicated project memory workspace.
When PHI is yes or unknown, enforce synthetic-only fixtures, examples, prompts, screenshots, logs, visual references, and generated documentation.
Add reusable design-memory guidance for principles, tokens, components, flows, screens, responsive states, accessibility, visual evidence, and variances.
Update coordination to request context before dispatch and accept worker memory deltas.
Update status and handoff to combine canonical memory with mutable control state.
Package provider-agnostic schemas and a local bridge script.
Keep project data, credentials, PHI, active queues, and repo-specific decisions out of plugin files.
acceptance: Plugin capability discovery supports Python or CLI integration without requiring either implementation language from target projects.
A missing expected memory runtime blocks only dependent slices.
Frontend slices receive design context and submit visual evidence or a documented not-applicable disposition.
PHI-capable or unknown projects reject non-synthetic design evidence and keep incident records metadata-only.
The plugin validates with no unsupported apps, MCP servers, or hooks.
Ordinary project work cannot mutate plugin source or cache.

phases.name: Documentation, validation, and adversarial review
tasks: Update generated docs and semantic HTML review surfaces.
Run focused and full repository validation.
Run fresh-context review for provenance, idempotence, concurrency, supersession, context bounds, PHI, secrets, screenshot safety, and design-baseline integrity.
Validate the plugin source, update cachebuster, reinstall locally, verify source-cache parity, and confirm plugin list state.
acceptance: All required repository checks pass or failures are preserved with exact evidence.
Source and installed plugin cache match after reinstall.
Fresh-thread skill-loading smoke test is identified as a supervised follow-up if it cannot occur in the active task.

phases.name: Durable stop and handoff
tasks: Stop accepting new feature scope.
Update queue, worker dispositions, incident evidence, validation lane, run-state, and handoff digest.
Record incomplete work as independent resumable slices with exact next actions.
Present supervision-required items and the fresh-thread smoke-test instructions.
acceptance: A future coordinator can resume without relying on chat history.
No active worker session or required validation process is abandoned.
The handoff distinguishes completed, validated, blocked, deferred, and supervision-required work.

assumptions: The initial implementation remains local-only and provider-agnostic.
The existing dirty worktree is intentional and must be preserved.
The user has approved planning artifacts but has not yet activated implementation through this artifact.
Preflight must ask whether the project handles PHI; yes or unknown activates synthetic-only development behavior until a later recorded answer or supersession changes it.
No real PHI will be used in implementation, tests, examples, screenshots, design references, logs, prompts, or documentation.
Newly reinstalled plugin skills require a fresh Codex task for final loading verification.
